newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algeria to start regular shipping run to UAE.
newsitem.headline: Algeria to start regular shipping run to UAE.

text.p: The Algerian National Navigation Company is to start a regular sea link with the United Arab Emirates, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Friday.
The decision followed President Liamine Zeroual's visit last month to the Gulf, said APS quoting a company source.
An inaugural voyage is planned late this month by the Algerian-flagged El-Ouarsenis.
According to the source, the company plans to have a vessel in Dubai every 21 days, with capacity for 7,500 tonnes of freight, either general cargo or in containers.
It hopes to extend the service to other areas of the Gulf and to serve other countries in North Africa, APS said.
